text:
Silver Price in 2025
Among 12 monthly observations available for 2025, the LBMA silver price rose 127.8% between 2025-01-31 ($31.61) and 2025-12-31 ($71.99). The highest sampled price was $71.99 in December and the lowest was $31.14 in February. The mean of these observations was $41.18. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
